title: SSM Automation runbook: roll back the agent endpoint
scenario: Rolling the AgentCore prod endpoint back is a hand-typed CLI call during incidents. Turn it into an SSM Automation runbook that reads and backs up the current state, waits for a release manager, moves the endpoint, waits for READY and fails if errors stay high. Runs on a local runbook interpreter with fake AWS APIs.
task: Read, no-op check, S3 backup, aws:approve
Update the endpoint and wait for READY with a timeout
Verify the error metric and fail above a threshold
acceptance: Happy path, rejection, timeout, threshold and no-op tests pass
ANSWER.md has a least-privilege assume role and the cross-account model

practices.label: Week 6 Tue - aws:approve and Change Manager
